title: Isandro and the Postcard
author: Ulyana Zhou
blurb: Bram Thackeray, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
